name: ASCEND Facial Measurement & Benchmark Reference
purpose: Versioned source-backed reference data for deterministic facial measurement analysis. Raw measurement calculation remains code; benchmarks remain data.
non_goals: This dataset does not claim universal human ideals.
Research-normality tiers are not attractiveness tiers.
FaceIQ proprietary scoring curves are not reconstructed.
provenance_enum: derived by assistant from published data

selection_policy.default: Prefer exact-definition, photo-compatible research for descriptive reference. Never substitute approximate landmark definitions silently.
selection_policy.faceiq: Use public FaceIQ formulas/definitions where useful; numeric FaceIQ scoring curve remains unavailable unless officially published.
selection_policy.community: Keep available as a separately selectable convention; never label as research or FaceIQ.
selection_policy.derived: May be used only when UI/metadata explicitly labels the derivation and its meaning.

capture_protocol.distance: ~2 m / 6 ft recommended by FaceIQ; avoid arm-length selfies
capture_protocol.camera: rear camera; longer focal length / 2× framing; eye-level
capture_protocol.expression: neutral, relaxed jaw, lips in repose
capture_protocol.scale: do not report physical mm without calibration; FaceIQ public docs describe 190 mm assumed face-height scaling for estimates
